newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best reviews USLIFE, American General.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best reviews USLIFE, American General.

text.p: A.M. Best Co on Thursday said it has placed its ratings on the insurance units of USLIFE Corp and the American General Group under review with developing implications.
The action follows the $1.8 billion merger between USLIFE with American General Corp, announced earlier on Thursday.
USLIFE subsidiaries affected include United States Life Insurance Co, All American Life Insurance Co, Old Line Life Insurance Company of America, and Credit Life Insurance Co., A.M. Best said.

The American General life insurance subsidiaries placed under review are AGC Life Insurance Co, American General Life Insurance Co, American General Life Insurance Company of New York, Franklin Life Insurance Co. Also, American Franklin Life Insurance Co, American General Life & Accident Insurance Co
Home Beneficial Life Insurance Co, Independent Life and Accident Insurance Co and Merit Life Insurance Co.

The ratings will remain under review pending further discussions with the management of American General and USLIFE Corp and the closing of the transaction, which is expected in mid-1997, A.M. Best said
The ratings of the property/casualty subsidiaries of American General and USLife are not affected by this action.
